phase: ## Phase S8: Default look for new editions
summary:
PASS at b5492228 with 0 Blockers and 4 Nits. Real-code probes on a temp WORKBOOKS_ROOT confirm that F5, F6, and F7 are fixed. Same-type creates gave exactly 1 success in each of 20 rounds. 7,200 look-less writes lost the look 0 times. A damaged project.json refuses a write with a 409, and no 409 or 500 body holds a server path.

The 4 Nits are API-level, and none changes a shipped look by itself. F8 is a create race across the two series folders. F9 is a lost update between an explicit look and an omitted look. F10 is a temp file with a guessable name that follows a symlink. F11 is 3 remediation claims with no test.
nonblocking_findings:
F8 [Nit] review-b: two creates of one new id with different types make the folder in both series folders (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:327-338, :348-356, and :402-404). The existence check reads both folders, and the atomic mkdir guards one folder, so a race remains between the two. The probe made both folders in 300 of 300 rounds with 2 requests, and in 100 of 100 rounds with 4 requests. The lookup takes secondary/ first (:44 and :77-98), so the Primary twin cannot be reached by id. No look flips and no file changes, and a shipped id keeps its 409. Only a direct API call reaches the race, because the dashboard options offer 0 ids to both types.
Fix: lock each id with a lock that does not depend on module state. Another fix: check secondary/ again after the primary mkdir. On a hit, remove the empty primary folder. Add a concurrent POST test for each pair of types.

F9 [Nit] review-b: a PUT with an explicit look and a PUT with no look, sent together, can lose the explicit look (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:231-236). writeProjectMetadata reads the stored look and writes it back later, with no lock between the two steps. The probe ended with the old look (classic) in 393 of 400 rounds and with the new look (chibi-quest) in 7. Both ordered runs give chibi-quest. A race returns only a stored look or a look that a client sent. It cannot make a shipped book chibi-quest by itself. The Settings dialog sends no look (dashboard/components/project-settings-dialog.tsx:75-80), so only a direct API call causes the loss.
Fix: serialize the writes of one project with a lock that does not depend on module state. Add a concurrent test for one explicit write and one omitted write.

F10 [Nit] review-b: writeFileAtomic opens the temp file with the default flag, and the name is easy to guess (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:246-248). The name is project.json.tmp-<pid>-<ms>-<8 base-36 characters of Math.random>. With the clock and Math.random fixed in the probe, a symlink at that name was followed. The write replaced a file outside the folder (S1) and made a new file outside the folder through a dangling link (S4). The rename then moved the link to project.json (S1). An attacker needs write access to the project folder, so no privilege gain exists today.
Fix: open the temp file with flag 'wx', and take the name from crypto.randomBytes(8).toString('hex').
Also: the new file takes the mode of the process umask (S6: 640 became 664, and the 6 repo files are already 664). A kill between the write and the rename leaves a project.json.tmp-* file that .gitignore:22 does not cover.

F11 [Nit] review-b: no test covers 3 claims of the remediation. The claims are the 409 for a damaged project.json (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:260-291 and dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/metadata/route.ts:70-72), the EEXIST mapping of concurrent creates (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:348-356), and the cleanup of the temp file (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:250-253). The only 409 assertions in dashboard/__tests__ are the 4 sequential create checks (adversarial-s8-default-look.test.ts:87, :100, :111, and :121). The concurrent PUT test (adversarial-s8-default-look.test.ts:198) injects a truncation only when the code writes the target in place, so it never meets a damaged file. The probes in this review cover all 3 claims.
Fix: add 3 short tests with a damaged project.json, a parallel create pair, and a rename that fails.

Scope: the 4 commits since bbe3d68f (9ad76f4a, 2d6056da, 9667be76, b5492228) change 5 files. 3 are dashboard files: lib/filesystem.ts, app/api/projects/[projectId]/metadata/route.ts, and the new __tests__/adversarial-s8-default-look.test.ts. 2 are measure files: tracks/primary_v2_look_20261020/plan.md and runs/primary_v2_look_20261020/green-s8-f699571a.log. primary/, secondary/, and content/ are unchanged, so no shipped project.json changed in this round.
CONTEST items: the round-3 brief routes no CONTEST item, so no finding is kept or withdrawn. F5, F6, and F7 are fixed, and the 3 entries below record the checks.

F5 verified fixed: a probe on a temp WORKBOOKS_ROOT sent 3 kinds of POST. They were a secondary twin of each shipped Primary id, a Primary twin of secondary/origins-3.1-a1, and the legacy name of a shipped id. Each gave 409 and made no folder. Crafted ids with dot segments and upper-case ids gave 409 too, so id normalization does not bypass the check (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:327-338, :372, and :402). The create dialog shows the 409 text as a React child (dashboard/components/create-project-dialog.tsx:153), so markup in an id prints as text.

F6 verified fixed: a PUT with look null gave 200 and kept the stored look (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:229-234), in the probe and in the two 'PUT look null preserves a stored marker' cases of the adversarial test. Unknown looks gave 400 and left the file bytes unchanged (dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/metadata/route.ts:56-64).

F7 verified fixed. Create: 8 concurrent creates of one new id gave 1 success and 7 ProjectExistsError in each of 20 rounds (round 2 gave 8 successes). Write: 6,400 concurrent look-less writes lost the look 0 times with 0 write errors and 0 temp files left. 800 writes through the PUT route lost it 0 times with 0 answers other than 200. Fail-closed: invalid JSON, an empty file, a directory (EISDIR), and a file with mode 000 (EACCES) gave 409 and left no temp file. A valid non-object JSON file ([]) is replaced, and a missing file is created. The comment at dashboard/__tests__/default-look-guards.test.ts:14-15 now holds for a same-type create and for a look-less write, and F8 and F9 are the exceptions.

Atomicity rests on the code path and on a failing-first test, not on a stress count. The write calls writeFile on the temp file and then rename, and it never opens the target for write (probe U1). The test adversarial-s8-default-look.test.ts:198 failed first at 9ad76f4a (green-s8-f699571a.log:55). The old code also lost 0 of 6,400 writes in round 2. My torn-read probe gave 0 torn reads for both a plain writeFile control and the new write, so that probe cannot tell the two apart.

Temp file: the name is project.json.tmp-<pid>-<Date.now()>-<8 base-36 characters of Math.random> in the folder of the target (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:246). 20 writes gave 20 distinct names (U1). With the clock and Math.random fixed, a symlink at the name was followed (S1, S4). A regular file at the name was overwritten (S2). A directory at the name gave EISDIR and an unchanged target (S3). A forced EXDEV error from rename and a partial write that fails with ENOSPC gave the same error to the caller, 0 temp files, and an unchanged target (U2, U3).

Rename across devices: the temp file is in the folder of the target, so EXDEV cannot occur between them in normal use. The PUT route answers a generic 500 with the constant text 'Failed to write project metadata' (dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/metadata/route.ts:73-77), and the server path stays in the server log.

Error bodies: the 409 of a create holds the client's id and a constant text. The 409 of a PUT holds a constant text (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:300 and :262). The 500 holds a constant text. No body in any probe held a server path. A successful create still returns the absolute folder path (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:388 and :418). That behavior stands at the phase base and is outside this audit.

Persistence: the rename replaces a symlinked project.json with a regular file, and the file behind the link stays unchanged (S5). The 6 project.json files in the repo are regular files, and find prints no symlink. A stale project.json.tmp-* file is not listed as a lesson or as a project (S7).

Note on the fail-closed read, as the brief asks: a damaged project.json blocks every PUT with 409. This includes a PUT with an explicit look, because readProjectLook runs for every write (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:231). The recovery path exists on disk only: remove or fix the file, then a PUT gives 200 (probe J). The Settings dialog shows no message for the 409 and writes console.error only (dashboard/components/project-settings-dialog.tsx:91-93). The file is in git, so the committed copy restores it. writeFileAtomic does not call fsync, so a power loss can leave an empty file on some file systems. The fail-closed read then blocks every Save until a person fixes the file.

Path safety and read-only mode: assertSafePath is lexical (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:51-60) and runs before each new check. assertWritable runs first in writeProjectMetadata and in createProject (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:223 and :362), before the look read, the folder check, and every write. The new helpers are not exported. Only the 2 error classes are exported. A symlinked project folder is outside this audit.
Pre-existing and outside the audited diff, not findings: the dashboard write routes have no authentication and no tenant or organization scope. The diff holds no migration.

Consumers: this round changes no project.json and no look key, so the round-1 result holds that the tutor-advantage importer (import-primary-workbooks.ts:71-74) and the monorepo dry-run (dry-run-import.ts:57-79) ignore the look key.

Secrets and Thai: a scan of the added lines of git diff bbe3d68f b5492228 -- dashboard finds no password, token, key, database URL, or home path. The added lines of lib/ and app/ hold no process.env, child_process, eval, or exec. The added lines hold 0 Thai characters. I read no lesson file.

A2: no round-3 line flips a draft to a published status, and the added lines hold no publish, consent, anonymization, or draft logic. A2 is not applicable. A6: measure/tracks.md has no change since bbe3d68f, and its row for this track (line 17) is open ([~]) with no resolved security claim. The plan and the Green log call the create race closed (green-s8-f699571a.log:56). That holds for creates of one type, and F8 shows the cross-type race.
